title: Universal first order thickenings and conormal sheaves restrict to open subschemes
statement: Let $h:Z\to X$ be a formally unramified morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism] and $Z\subset Z'$ a universal first order thickening of $Z$ over $X$ [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening]. Let $V\subset Z$ and $U\subset X$ be open subschemes [def-weil-open-immersion] with $h(V)\subset U$, and let $V'\subset Z'$ be the open subscheme with $V=Z\cap V'$ (it has the same underlying set as $V$, since $Z$ and $Z'$ have the same underlying space). Then $h|_V:V\to U$ is formally unramified, $V\subset V'$ (with $V'\to U$ the restriction of $Z'\to X$) is a universal first order thickening of $V$ over $U$, and consequently $\mathcal C_{Z/X}|_V\cong\mathcal C_{V/U}$ [def-weil-pbc-conormal-sheaf-formally-unramified].

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FA (lemma-universal-thickening-localize), with Lemma 02HC (lemma-formally-unramified-on-opens) for the first assertion
